RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Storm Flywheel
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Grants Storm Spin and Wind-down Strike. Starting a spin grants 24 shield, at most once every 8 seconds regardless of haste or cooldown refunds. Every 0.5 seconds, hit up to 8 enemies for 3.5 base ability damage. The first 3 seconds cost no shield; each later pulse spends 8 shield, for at most 12 seconds total. Reserve 0/10/25/50 shield with the pawn command (default 10). Movement remains available; standing still grows the radius from 3 to 4.5 cells. Wind-down ends the spin and strikes one enemy for 8 plus 1.5 per completed pulse, capped at 44 base damage. Existing spin abilities also start the flywheel, but cannot stack or refresh an active spin.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Prismatic Magazine
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Stores 5 prismatic rounds. A damaging basic ranged hit on an enemy spends one round for 6 extra base damage; the last round deals 10. At most one round is spent per 0.25 seconds; pellets and secondary procs cannot spend extra rounds. Lethal hits still spend a round. After 3 seconds without spending ammunition, restore one round, then one every 2 seconds. Walking 6 sampled cells restores one round, at most once per 2 seconds; movement abilities do not count. Grants Empty the Magazine: spend every remaining round for 7 base ability damage each. Requires an equipped ranged weapon. Autocast waits for a full magazine.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Resonance Node
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Grants Deploy Node, Resonance Pulse and Recall Node. Place a stationary projection lasting 30 seconds within 12 cells, or designate one of your own summons as a relay. A relay must remain within 18 cells of its owner with clear line of sight. Resonance Pulse, Crystal bolt and Aid pulse cast from the linked summon; range and sight are measured from it. Other abilities are unchanged. A broken link falls back to the caster. Resonance Pulse deals 14 base damage. Recall consumes the designated summon, grants 16 shield and strengthens the next Resonance Pulse within 6 seconds to 21 base damage. Recall is manual only and can be used once every 6 seconds, regardless of haste or cooldown refunds.
